strings.<b>Design checks</b>: the engineer's rep: Design checks: the engineer's report lists problems (red blocks launch). Keep launch TWR above ~1.3, the centre of pressure (cyan) below the centre of mass (yellow), a heat shield under crew pods that return from orbit, and a parachute. Orbit takes about 3,400 m/s; a trip to a Luma landing and back needs roughly 6,000–6,300 m/s plus margin (the Luma Pathfinder starter carries about 7,600 m/s in vacuum). Low thrust-to-weight upper stages are fine in space; a lander needs a local TWR above ~1.5 at Luma (switch the readout to Luma surface).
